name: context-menu-demo
title: Context Menu demo
description: Browser-style actions on an area, with shortcuts, a submenu, checkbox and radio items.

files.content:
import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { NdIcon } from '@ndop/core'; import { ContextMenuCheckboxItem, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuItemIndicator, ContextMenuLabel, ContextMenuRadioItem, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuShortcut, ContextMenuSubContent, ContextMenuSubTrigger, } from '@/ui/context-menu/context-menu'; import { NdMenuRadioGroup as ContextMenuRadioGroup } from '@ndop/primitives/menu'; import { NdContextMenuTrigger as ContextMenuTrigger } from '@ndop/primitives/context-menu'; /** * Browser-style actions on an area: shortcuts, a disabled item, a submenu, * a checkbox and a group of radios. The area is focusable and named, so * Shift + F10 opens the menu from the keyboard. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-context-menu-demo', imports: [ ContextMenuCheckboxItem, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuItemIndicator, ContextMenuLabel, ContextMenuRadioGroup, ContextMenuRadioItem, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuShortcut, ContextMenuSubContent, ContextMenuSubTrigger, ContextMenuTrigger, NdIcon, ], template: `
Right click here
Back ⌘[
Forward ⌘]
Reload ⌘R
More tools
Show bookmarks
People
@for (name of people; track name) {
{{ name }}
}
Save page…
Developer tools
Delete
 `, }) export class ContextMenuDemoExample { protected readonly bookmarks = signal(true); protected readonly people = ['Pedro Duarte', 'Colm Tuite']; protected readonly person = signal('Pedro Duarte'); }
